title: Affiliate ads follow the conversation
summary:
Text API work made affiliate copy more contextual and browser errors easier to inspect, with a tracking pixel added behind the scenes.

Affiliate copy is now generated as a short sentence using the current response and the last three conversation messages, rather than translating existing ad text. The `p-ads` marker still guides ad generation but is removed before messages reach the text model.

The text cache now adds a CORS header to non-OK origin responses, so cross-origin browser requests can inspect errors instead of losing them to the browser’s CORS checks.

A non-cacheable tracking-pixel function was added for analytics. The text cache also moved to a named origin address.
